revision: R1 consolidated rework of B2D-F01 to B2D-F06

corpusBoundary.note: selected regions of named sources only; no all-files-read claim; no repository-wide absence claim

sourceManifest.disposition: REUSE identity only; candidate cannot represent acceptance
REJECT as acceptance authority: read calls init (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS), write upserts, synchronous NORMAL, mkdir on open
REJECT as owner; in-memory, content-hash dedup returns existing entry across artifacts, no bytes or actor; borrow lineage idea only
ADAPT patterns only; events not bytes; Python; constructor and _connect are not write-free
CONSUMER; writes nothing; receiptAnchor is an HTML section id, not an artifact key
REUSE as actor source; registry change needed for a new route
REUSE session fields; impersonation handled by refusal
PROPOSAL INPUT, delta added in the design document

sourceManifest.selectedRegions: Byte Values That Must Not Be Confused; custody rules

sourceManifest.disposition: ACCEPT owner gap; do not retrofit governance table
existing dependency; no new dependency proposed

selectedProfileDelta: server-established actor, role and scope bound to operation, version and bytes
dedicated store adapted from named patterns, four existing owners rejected as acceptance authority
one append-only hash-chained journal; counters, epoch and restore generation derived (F01)
total operation state machine with terminal outcomes and intent check in every state (F02)
operating-system lock for the writer lifetime and a fresh epoch per lifetime (F04)
freshness witness over the journal sequence as a hard admission blocker, fail-closed reads, restore with declared loss (F05)
exact-intent acknowledgment, pre-write versus post-intent refusal effects, lineage information separate from acknowledgment (F06)
classification on a scratch byte copy, never opening the live store for write

ownerDispositions.gap: no actor, decision, workspace, operation or persistence
read calls init and creates storage; write upserts; synchronous NORMAL; no schema, actor or immutability
in-memory; content-hash dedup returns existing entry across artifacts; no bytes or actor
events not bytes; Python runtime; constructor and connect are not write-free
no accept route; no workspace mapping; no artifact key

findings: read-init gap: generic adapter read creates storage, so a wrong or missing directory yields a false null
upsert gap: generic adapter write replaces accepted bytes
no stable artifact lineage key exists; receiptAnchor is an HTML section id
no workspace definition exists; session exposes orgId and teamId only
governance ledger read path also sets journal mode, so its classification precedent is copy based
v3 ledger header says duplicates throw but the code returns the existing entry
R0 review findings B2D-F01 to B2D-F06 are the R1 input; they are document-state contradictions, not observed runtime failures
openDesignChoicesForLocal: two-transaction commit with positive attempt record
one append-only journal instead of mutable control fields
operating-system lock for the writer lifetime and fresh epoch per lifetime
terminal operations never reopen and need a new operationId
lineage head first with no fallback
witness over the journal sequence as hard admission blocker
artifactKey introduced as a new validated slug
unknownFutureGates: operating-system lock mechanism choice for the host
real witness location, owner, custody, retention and availability

B2D-F01.resolution: append-only hash-chained journal; sequence, epoch and restore generation derived; takeover and restore are appended entries; rollback rejected by sequence, chain, epoch and witness rules

B2D-F02.resolution: five-state operation machine with terminal outcomes that never reopen; intent check in every state; shared blob verified and reused without a second insert

B2D-F03.resolution: lineage head first; revoked or expired head leaves no effective acceptance; basedOnDecisionId is the head even when ineffective

B2D-F04.resolution: exclusive operating-system lock for the writer lifetime plus a fresh epoch per lifetime; crash, release, hung and takeover rules; second process refused

B2D-F05.resolution: witness over the single journal sequence; freshness rule; fail closed for writer admission and current claims; terminal negatives prefix-safe; restore declares loss

B2D-F06.resolution: pre-write versus post-intent effects tabulated; acknowledgment bound to the exact intent; lineage information is not an acknowledgment; INTENT_CONFLICT classification
